items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: I used to play with that band too, the E-Rica band.

ctx.x: The fella was dying. And John Kazimer with the tuxedo and Big Red, he got the E-Rica band. Yeah. Yeah. I used to play with that band too, the E-Rica band. Oh, you did. But I didn't stay with them because I always was traveling with Howard and them, and I didn't have time to be there with them. Because the way they'd get their job, they'd get it when somebody died, or eat a parade, and that wasn't regular enough for me. So I stayed at the orchestra with him. Of course, we played a lot of funerals and things…
Who would you say was about the best drummer down there you ever heard? Did you have a favorite?
